web.orders: order and trade topics on a dedicated MQTT connection (prod/updates/order/v1, prod/updates/trade/v1)

notes: IIFL streams five levels; every subscribe is acknowledged with depth 5 in every mode (iiflcapital_adapter.py:303), as the desktop does (feed::dialect, DepthAck::Five).

The desktop reaches IIFL's MQTT bridge through a loopback relay (brokers/iiflcapital/mqtt_relay.rs); the corpus plays the relay's side, so the MQTT session itself (credentials, clean session, keepalive) is covered by the broker's unit tests, not here.
